projects.name: Downtown UAQ
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Downtown Umm Al Quwain, a large-scale coastal city spanning 25 million square feet in Umm Al Quwain. Designed as a mixed-use development, it will feature luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality districts, organized into three main areas: North Beach, Trade Centre, and South Beach. A continuous 11-kilometre stretch of coastline, including 7 kilometres of natural beaches and parks, will serve as a signature element of the development, enhancing its appeal for leisure, tourism, and waterfront living.

At the heart of the project lies the UAQ Trade Centre Free Zone, a 15 million square foot business hub operating under an independent legal framework aimed at attracting global investors and fostering economic growth. Downtown Umm Al Quwain will include residential communities, commercial offices, luxurious five-star hotels and resorts, retail destinations, and entertainment hubs. The project is planned to house over 150,000 residents and will dedicate 50% of its land to green spaces, parks, landscaped gardens, and natural corridors to promote a sustainable, high-quality living environment.

The development prioritizes modern infrastructure with a focus on water conservation, marine protection strategies, and ecological harmony, positioning itself as a model for responsible urban growth and a premier destination for investors, residents, and tourists alike.

Downtown UAQ is a greenfield mega urban development project in Umm Al Quwain, valued at USD 3000.0 million, at concept. Developed by Sobha Realty,Government Of Umm Al Quwain. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: The Next Chapter - Jumeirah Golf Estates
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a large-scale, mixed-use community called The Next Chapter at Jumeirah Golf Estates. The masterplan spans 4.68 million square meters and marks a major expansion of the iconic Jumeirah Golf Estates community. This premium development is set to deliver approximately 12,000 new residential units, including a variety of luxurious housing options such as 62 exclusive hilltop mansions.
The project is divided into several distinct zones, each offering unique features:

  • Central Park District: Approximately 5,088 residential units
  • Equestrian Village: Approximately 512 homes catering to lifestyle and sporting enthusiasts
  • Golf Course North and South: Integrated with a new 18-hole golf course, enhancing the golfing experience and surrounding residential zones
  • Tennis Stadium Complex: Around 816 residential units alongside Dubai’s largest tennis stadium with a 5,000+ spectator capacity
  • Town Centre: Approximately 1,117 residential units serving as a vibrant commercial and social hub
  • Village District: Approximately 2,976 residential units offering family-friendly living spaces


Beyond premium residences, the development prioritizes wellness, leisure, and retail, featuring a vast 1.5 million square meters of green and open space, alongside 48,000 square meters dedicated to retail and food & beverage outlets. The community integrates extensive sports facilities, including multi-purpose complexes, swimming lakes, and fitness centers, all within a carefully landscaped, eco-friendly urban environment.

At the core of the community lies a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course with a clubhouse, driving range, and dedicated golf academy, solidifying Jumeirah Golf Estates’ legacy as a world-class golf destination. Additionally, a state-of-the-art equestrian center specialized in show jumping offers premium stables, training arenas, and competition facilities, fostering a vibrant equestrian community.

Anchored by a sprawling 131,850 square meter Central Park, the community’s infrastructure includes an international academy on a 46,000 square meter plot, nurseries, healthcare facilities, multiple mosques, and civic amenities, ensuring convenience and liveability for residents of all ages.

This visionary development sets a new benchmark for sustainable, luxurious urban living in Dubai, combining world-class amenities, diverse housing options, and seamless integration with nature and sports, creating a legacy community for generations to come.

The Next Chapter - Jumeirah Golf Estates is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 6000.0 million, at concept. Developed by Wasl Asset Management,Wasl (Dubai Real Estate Corporation) (Drec). No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Milan Heights - Azizi Milan
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Milan Heights, a high-rise residential district within the Azizi Milan master development, located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road in Dubai. Designed to harmonize Italian-inspired elegance with contemporary urban living, Milan Heights consists of eight individual towers offering a mix of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, with an estimated 5,800 residential units in total.

Towers and Storeys:

  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower A – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower B – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower C – 47 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower D – 47 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower E – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower F – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower G – 47 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower H – 47 storeys

Residents will enjoy access to an extensive range of integrated lifestyle amenities, including six infinity swimming pools, a lagoon-style pool, five kids’ pools, rooftop infinity pools, a state-of-the-art cinema, fully equipped fitness centre, jogging and bicycle tracks, saunas, jacuzzis, steam rooms, a multipurpose hall, BBQ areas, children’s play zones, and 24/7 security.

The development also offers over 20,000 square metres of retail space, delivering a vibrant, community-centric experience with everyday conveniences.

Architectural design is inspired by Italian sophistication, featuring bold arches, panoramic elevators, and landscaped rooftop gardens. These buildings provide scenic views of green open spaces, water features, and recreational zones. Milan Heights supports Azizi’s broader goal of creating a sustainable, human-centric, mixed-use community, aligned with the Azizi Milan master plan.

Milan Heights - Azizi Milan is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 2000.0 million, at design. Developed by Azizi Developments. Lead consultant 360 Degrees Architectural Design Consultancy. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: 450 Townhouses - Al Deem Community

The project involves the construction of 450 townhomes located northeast of Yas Island in Abu Dhabi. The townhomes, comprising three- and four-bedroom units, are thoughtfully designed to blend contemporary living with traditional Emirati values, featuring majlis spaces, multiple entrances, and energy-efficient layouts. Notably, the development includes 26 live-work homes, a first-of-its-kind concept in the UAE, with commercial space on the ground floor and private residences above, allowing for flexible use such as cafés, studios, or retail outlets.

Set within a pedestrian-friendly environment rich in green spaces, the community offers access to a wide range of amenities including schools, mosques, health centres, retail and F&B outlets, parks, and an eco-loop for walking and jogging. Residents will also enjoy sports facilities, an equestrian centre, and an 8.2 km cycling track. Two new bridges will connect Al Deem directly to Yas Island, providing seamless access to major attractions and a quick commute to Zayed International Airport and central Abu Dhabi.

Developed by Aldar, this family-oriented residential cluster is the seventh phase of the broader Al Deem masterplan, formerly known as Balghaiylam, and is part of Abu Dhabi’s national housing programme in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Housing Authority. 450 Townhouses - Al Deem Community is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 350.0 million, at design. The mall is designed to offer visitors an immersive experience, blending technology, nature, and human-centric design to provide a unique community hub. Strategically located on Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), the development is well-positioned to attract flagship and anchor tenants seeking early entry into a high-growth, premium catchment area.

For residents, the mall promises a vibrant hub of opportunity, convenience, and connection, while serving as a central destination for visitors across Dubai. projects.name: Tiger Sky Tower - Business Bay
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 122-story residential tower in Business Bay. Soaring an impressive height of 532 meters, this building is set to break height records. The project will also house the world’s highest penthouse at 427 meters. The architectural renderings of Dubai’s Tiger Sky Tower are stunning, showcasing rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows that offer views of the nearby Burj Khalifa.

The project offers 849 fully furnished luxury residential units, comprising 208 1-bedroom, 414 2-bedroom, 158 3-bedroom, and 50 4-bedroom apartments, catering to various preferences with spacious layouts and high-end finishes for modern living comfort.

Positioned as the world’s tallest residential building next to the Burj Khalifa, the Tiger Sky Tower features impressive amenities. These include a basketball court surrounded by lush greenery and a lounge area adorned with palm trees. Additionally, the building will host the world’s highest adventure park, infinity pool, and restaurant.

Other facilities include a cigar lounge, a kids’ play area, a gym, shops, and a spa. Notably, the Tiger Sky Tower will also feature the tallest rainforest within a residential building in the world.

projects.name: Lavita - The Oasis
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Lavita at The Oasis, a prestigious residential enclave by Emaar Properties offering a selection of 6 and 7-bedroom mansions. Nestled within The Oasis, this development epitomizes opulence and elegance with its expansive layouts and breathtaking architectural style. Each of the 43 signature mansions is crafted to blend seamlessly with its serene surroundings of water canals, shimmering lakes, and lush parks, creating an ideal environment for a tranquil lifestyle. The design philosophy combines classic elements with contemporary aesthetics, reflecting a mastery of form, function, and luxury.

Lavita at The Oasis features four distinct facade styles—Ayanna, Aman, Faya, and Naya—each bringing a unique architectural vision while maintaining a harmonious community aesthetic. The mansions are designed with meticulous attention to detail, using high-quality materials like polished marble, rich wood accents, glass, and metal to create an inviting and elegant ambiance. Beyond the opulent interiors, Lavita offers a range of amenities, including landscaped parks, jogging tracks, wellness centers, and luxury boutiques, ensuring that residents enjoy a well-rounded lifestyle within their private sanctuary.

Located in close proximity to major transportation routes such as Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road (D54) and the future extension of Al Khail Road (E44), Lavita provides a seamless connection to Dubai’s vibrant attractions while offering a peaceful retreat from the city’s fast pace. The development is part of The Oasis, an expansive 100 million square feet masterpiece that includes over 7,000 residences, with a focus on majestic super-mansions, mansions, and villas. Lavita combines luxury and serenity, providing a haven where privacy meets connectivity, and every moment offers a chance to relax and rejuvenate amidst a backdrop of stunning natural beauty.

Lavita - The Oasis is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 45.0 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). Developed by Emaar Properties Pjsc. Lead consultant Bma Studio. Main contractor Ginco Contracting Co. (Gcc); MEP contractor Ginco Contracting Co. (Gcc). Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Taraf - Residential Community - Masdar City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 1.4 million square meter residential community in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi’s flagship sustainable urban hub. Designed to promote modern, eco-conscious living, the development will feature a curated mix of 2–6 bedroom villas and townhouses, arranged within neighborhood clusters that encourage social interaction and family-friendly environments.

The master plan emphasizes green spaces, shaded walkways, and cycling routes that connect directly to Al Masar Park, creating a seamless integration with Masdar City’s broader ecosystem. More than 1,000 single-family homes are envisioned, complemented by dedicated clubs, parks, and expansive walkable open areas.

This new community sets a benchmark for sustainable urban living in the UAE, offering freehold ownership opportunities, modern infrastructure, and lifestyle amenities that support wellbeing, convenience, and active living—all within a vibrant, low-carbon environment. Taraf - Residential Community - Masdar City is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 1500.0 million, at design. Developed by Taraf Holding,Masdar City Llc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: One Sky Park by Iman Developers - Jumeirah Village Circle
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of residential towers in Jumeirah Village Circle. The project consists of two iconic towers. Tower A consists of a basement level, a ground floor, 4 parking floors, and 26 additional floors, while Tower B has a basement level, a ground floor, 4 parking floors, and 37 additional floors. The development includes 575 residential apartments and 12 retail units, respectively, each crowned with a stunning Sky Deck. Offering a mix of studios, one to three-bedroom apartments, and luxurious penthouses.

 The project will include an array of premium amenities, including a state-of-the-art Skyfit gym, multiple fitness and wellness centers, and the Sky Deck—a unique social hub offering panoramic views of Dubai's skyline. Residents will also enjoy an infinity pool, hammock park, yoga deck, kids’ splash pad, padel and basketball courts, an outdoor cinema, a forest trail, and a zen garden. Indoor amenities include a multi-purpose hall, a games room, and an indoor kids' play area. The use of high-quality materials such as porcelain floor and wall tiles from Versace Ceramics and Stone Grey Frozen Wood throughout each unit reflects the development's dedication to sophisticated design and luxury.

projects.name: Expansion of Rochester Institute of Technology - Phase 2 - Dubai Silicon Oasis
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a major expansion of the RIT Dubai campus at Dubai Silicon Oasis. The development spans 85,000 square meters, increasing the campus’s built-up area by 217%, bringing the total area to 124,000 square meters. Upon completion, the campus will be able to accommodate approximately 4,500 students, a 115% increase in capacity. The expansion includes the construction of nine new academic and administrative buildings, offering advanced educational facilities, modern laboratories, research spaces, and an expanded parking structure.

projects.name: Yas Bay Beachfront Development - Yas Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of two beaches at Yas Bay Waterfront, a lively day-to-night destination situated on Yas Island. These additions will complement the existing lifestyle and leisure offerings at the destination, with each beach spanning a length of 280 meters, totaling 560 meters.

The West Beach, situated on the west side of the pier, is tailored as a family-friendly destination. It will feature beachside play areas for children, upscale dining options, food trucks, pedestrian walkways, and amenities for rest.

The East Beach, located on the east side of the pier near the acclaimed Etihad Arena, will offer outdoor fitness areas and sports zones for beach football and volleyball. Open seating areas, along with a sunset lounge, will provide opportunities for visitors to enjoy various sports, entertainment, and music events.

These beaches will serve as exciting additions to the iconic leisure and lifestyle experiences at Yas Bay Waterfront, which boasts over 20 alfresco restaurants and cafe, world-class nightlife venues, a floating beach club, an award-winning concert arena, luxury hotels, and a sprawling promenade.


Both developments will be conveniently located just minutes away from Yas Island's renowned attractions and experiences, including SeaWorld, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, Ferrari World Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, CLYMB, Abu Dhabi, Yas Waterworld Abu Dhabi, and Yas Marina

Yas Bay Beachfront Development - Yas Island is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 40.0 million, at under construction (10.0 percent complete). Developed by Miral Developers. Lead consultant Zutari Africa Ltd. Main contractor Tornado General Contracting (Abu Dhabi). Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project amenities will include schools, swimming pools, a gym, private parking for each unit as well as plenty of green space, private parking for each unit, shaded seating areas, kids’ swimming Pools, a gymnasium, a jogging track, tennis courts, multi-sports court, croquet areas, zen garden, yoga garden, BBQ areas, pets areas, kids’ playgrounds, bocce play areas, giant chess play area, nursery, mosque, and, 24 / 7 security.

The project unit features will include:- 

  • Private Balconies / Terraces as per unit plan
  •  Built-in wardrobes in bedrooms

  • 4 bedrooms townhouses with internal elevator

projects.name: Abu Al Kizan Shoreline Village - Khorffakkan
projects.description: The project involves the construction of Abu Al Kizan shoreline village, southeast of Khor Fakkan City, in the mountainous area that spreads into the sea. The designs of the project’s buildings and amenities will be inspired by the Italian village of Riomaggiore. The village design takes a spiral shape to accommodate the mountain it is built upon, where the valley acts as a central road with buildings on both sides. The project consists of two parts: The first part is located on the shoreline and is about 60,000 sqm in area. It includes restaurants, shops, hotel rooms, and private residences, in addition to a marina, a yacht club, and swimming pools. The other part of the project is located higher on the mountain and is about 30,000 sqm in area. It will include high-end restaurants, shops, and hotels, with an elevated view of the sea. projects.name: Nautis Residences - Dubai Islands
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Nautis Residences, a premium mid-rise residential development located at the heart of Island A within Dubai Islands. The project comprises a ground floor, two parking levels, and eight residential floors, offering a total of 63 limited-edition freehold units. These include one-, two-, and three-bedroom luxury apartments, as well as three exclusive four-bedroom townhouses.

Nautis Residences draws architectural inspiration from the waves of the Arabian Gulf, as envisioned by design consultant Horizon. The development features a suite of high-end amenities such as an infinity pool and sundeck, a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, reading garden, barbecue areas, children's play zone, and a dedicated kids’ pool. The residences are strategically located near the upcoming Dubai Islands Mall and benefit from seamless connectivity to both Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport via interconnecting bridges.

In addition to its location near vital retail, leisure, and hospitality nodes, the project is part of a broader master plan offering 60 kilometers of coastline, access to yacht marinas, schools, healthcare facilities, and entertainment venues. 

Nautis Residences - Dubai Islands is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 21.0 million, at design. Developed by Stamn Real Estate Development. Residents will benefit from over 30 lifestyle amenities, including a temperature-controlled infinity pool, Japanese garden, sky observatory deck, rooftop sky beach lounge, open-air sky cinema, and aquatic fitness zone. Additional facilities include a state-of-the-art gym, padel court, yoga and Zumba areas, adventure sports zone, children’s play area, private spa and hammam, luxury beauty center, exclusive cigar lounge, celebration hall, BBQ area, and co-working lounge.

Further enriching the community experience, the project also integrates fine dining outlets, retail and leisure spaces, an on-site medical clinic, and private beach access, all secured with 24/7 surveillance and management. Strategically located in RAK Central, the development ensures strong connectivity to retail, healthcare, and transport hubs, making it a promising choice for both end-users and investors.

projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Soto Grande, a premium residential development strategically located in Al Hamra, Ras Al Khaimah. The development is designed as two striking residential volumes connected by a distinctive bridge, creating a bold architectural statement that symbolizes balance, belonging, and community.

Soto Grande will feature approximately 600 residential units, offering a mix of thoughtfully designed studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious four-bedroom residences and penthouses. The bridge will incorporate a 60-meter infinity pool, providing residents with a unique vantage point across the lagoon, golf course, cityscape, and Arabian Gulf.

The development emphasizes a lifestyle-first approach with a wide range of amenities. Residents will be welcomed by a hotel-inspired lobby and lounge complemented by concierge services, while a private clubhouse will provide a hub for dining, entertainment, and social gatherings. Wellness facilities include a double-height fitness studio overlooking the pool, a yoga and pilates centre with a refreshment bar, spa-style changing rooms with sauna and chromatherapy showers, and an outdoor gym.

Family-friendly features include children’s play areas, landscaped outdoor play zones, a padel court, lap and leisure pools, and dedicated facilities for parents, such as a nursing room. The community experience will be further enriched with curated art installations and Ellington’s signature hospitality fragrance integrated into public spaces.

Soto Grande by Ellington is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 408.0 million, at design. Developed by Ellington Properties Development Llc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The residential development will provide an exceptional living experience, with access to resort-style amenities and services on demand. This development is poised to enhance Ras Al Khaimah’s position as a premier destination for both luxury living and tourism.

The Luxury Collection Resort & Residences aims to contribute to the region's tourism sector growth, further cementing Ras Al Khaimah’s reputation as a world-class destination.

projects.name: Wadeem - Hudayriyat Island
projects.description:
The project involves the development of Wadeem, a premium residential community by Modon on Hudayriyat Island in Abu Dhabi. As the first residential plots offering on the island, Wadeem provides prospective homeowners the rare opportunity to design and build bespoke villas in one of the emirate’s most sought-after and scenic emerging neighborhoods. Situated directly opposite the prestigious Al Bateen area, this launch marks the first availability of land so close to central Abu Dhabi’s elite zones in over 15 years.

Wadeem comprises more than 1,700 residential plots, each large enough to accommodate four- to six-bedroom villas with private swimming pools and spacious outdoor entertainment areas. Strategically located near the island’s coastline, many plots offer breathtaking views of the Abu Dhabi skyline and seamless access to pristine beaches and the Gulf’s serene waters.

The community is designed with a strong focus on wellness and connectivity, featuring a walkable layout with cycling paths interwoven through lush green landscapes. At the center of Wadeem will be a vibrant community hub, complete with a central park, a mosque, a private school, and various retail outlets. For active lifestyles, the development will include a recreational complex with swimming pools, a jogging track, sports courts, and dedicated areas for yoga and meditation.

Residents of Wadeem will also enjoy proximity to Hudayriyat Island’s world-class leisure, hospitality, and adventure attractions, including Nawayef Park, Surf Abu Dhabi, Velodrome Abu Dhabi, 321 Sports, Circuit X, Trail X, Marsana Beach, Bab Al Nojoum beach resort, and the upcoming largest urban park in the emirate.

Wadeem - Hudayriyat Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 425.0 million, at concept. Developed by Modon Properties. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Mark & Save Mall - Al Khan
projects.description: The project involves the construction of a fully redeveloped retail destination at the former Safeer Mall site in Sharjah, now provisionally named Mark & Save Mall. Located on Etihad Road (E11), Al Khan, one of the busiest highways in the UAE, the development aims to create a next-generation shopping and leisure experience tailored to modern consumer expectations. The redevelopment will encompass comprehensive upgrades to the mall’s interior, exterior, and surrounding infrastructure. The existing structure will not be demolished, but significant sections of the interior and core infrastructure will be rebuilt to meet contemporary standards and government regulations. The transformation includes a complete overhaul of the layout to improve customer flow and experience, bringing a fresh, contemporary aesthetic to the iconic location. Key features of the revamped mall will include Sharjah’s largest indoor family play area, a broad selection of international dining options, a fully serviced gym, and a value-focused retail hypermarket under the group’s Mark & Save brand. The mall is also expected to serve as a community hub, fostering economic growth by creating hundreds of new jobs across sectors such as retail, hospitality, entertainment, logistics, and facility management. Mark & Save Mall - Al Khan is a greenfield shopping mall project in Sharjah, valued at USD 272.3 million, at concept. Developed by Western International Llc,Mark & Save. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Sparklz by Danube - Al Furjan
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 15-storey residential building named Sparklz by Danube, located in the Al Furjan community of Dubai's Jebel Ali District. Designed to blend modern living with functional design, the development will offer approximately 356 residential units, including flex studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments. Unique convertible units will also be featured, allowing residents to transform one-bedroom layouts into two-bedroom configurations for added flexibility.

Strategically positioned for excellent connectivity, the project offers immediate access to the metro station and Dubai’s key arterial roads, ensuring ease of travel across the emirate. The building will rise to a height of approximately 65 meters (213 feet) and will be equipped with over 30 premium lifestyle amenities. These include a cricket pitch, football court, jogging track, swimming pools, a wellness center, an outdoor cinema, BBQ area, children’s play zone, and a fully equipped gym. A standout feature is the “nanny-on-board” service, a first-of-its-kind offering in the UAE, aimed at supporting young families.

Sparklz by Danube is tailored to deliver a holistic living experience, combining luxury, community-centric features, and thoughtful functionality for residents.

Sparklz by Danube - Al Furjan is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 80.0 million, at design. Developed by Danube Properties. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: eSports Island - Al Raha Beach
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the world's first eSports Island in Al Raha Beach, Abu Dhabi, which will include a lavish hotel with a distinctive concept, state-of-the-art gaming venues for tournaments, professional training facilities, and spaces for content creation.

GG Bootcamps will cater to serious gamers gearing up for tournaments, providing cutting-edge computers, advanced analytical tools, designated rest areas, and a balanced nutrition program. Additionally, a children's eSports camp will nurture future gaming enthusiasts.

The GG Resort, offering 200 luxurious rooms, will feature high-performance computers and leisure facilities like a spa, pool, and beach for gamers to unwind.

The Digital Tower will serve as a modern business hub, housing workspaces and animation development studios.

The TG Arena will host international eSports tournaments, digital exhibitions, and conferences, accommodating various gaming genres and competition formats. It will include a computer club, car simulator area, console zone, and fully equipped streaming area.

Spanning across four towers, low rise towers Coastline Beach Residences presents an impressive selection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and luxurious 2 and 3-bedroom duplexes. The project involves the construction of Keturah Ardh, a visionary luxury residential and mixed-use development spanning approximately 18.47 million square feet in Dubai’s Al Rowaiyah First District. This development aims to set new benchmarks for sustainable and innovative living environments in line with Dubai’s 2040 Urban Master Plan.

The masterplan includes plot sizes ranging from 50,000 to 200,000 square feet, providing a variety of residential and commercial opportunities. A standout feature is the integration of over 100,000 trees aged between 20 and 2,200 years, utilizing an innovative 'Life-Scaping' approach that fuses nature with the built environment to improve air quality and promote emotional wellbeing. This approach underscores a strong commitment to environmental sustainability and holistic urban design.

The development will blend art, wellness, and luxury living through its “Keturah Ardh Couture Art” brand, designed to nurture community engagement and promote a harmonious lifestyle with nature. The project encourages collaboration with top-tier architects, designers, fashion brands, and artists to ensure a culturally rich and aesthetically sophisticated environment.

A diverse range of amenities caters to various interests, making it an ideal haven for both adventure seekers and those desiring peaceful retreats. The project involves the construction of Symbolic Zen Residences, a 21-storey premium residential building in Al Furjan, Jebel Ali District, Dubai. It includes a basement level for parking, a ground floor, two podium levels, 16 residential floors, and a rooftop leisure area.

Symbolic Zen Residences will feature 82 exclusive, fully furnished units comprising 2.5-bedroom apartments and 3.5-bedroom garden residences. These homes are Vaastu-compliant and include closed kitchens, en-suite bedrooms, expansive 12-foot ceilings, panoramic balconies, and private garden terraces. The layout maximizes natural light, ventilation, and views, reflecting a commitment to mindful living.

Designed as a wellness-focused sanctuary, the development offers a range of premium lifestyle amenities, including temperature-controlled pools, a rooftop yoga and meditation deck, jogging track, children’s play area, jacuzzi, steam and sauna rooms, and co-working spaces. The rooftop wellness deck and Zen gardens foster a calm and connected community environment. The project also includes smart home automation, EV charging stations, and sustainable building materials.

Located on a corner plot with roads on three sides along Al Asayel Street, the development provides unobstructed views and abundant natural light. It is just two minutes from Discovery Gardens Metro Station, offering excellent connectivity to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Expo City, and major airports. Retail showrooms on the ground floor provide added convenience, while the elevated podium level ensures privacy and separation from urban bustle.

Symbolic Zen Residences - Al Furjan is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 57.2 million, at design. Developed by Symbolic Real Estate Development Llc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of 15 Cascade, a residential building located in Motor City (now renamed to Al Hebiah First) within DubaiLand, Dubai. The development will include a ground floor, two basement levels, and 15 additional floors. It will comprise approximately 430 residential units, offering a mix of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, four-bedroom penthouses, and duplex units with private pools, in addition to 10 retail outlets.

Designed as an iconic architectural statement, 15 Cascade is featured by Versace Ceramics and is situated at the entrance of Al Hebiah First. The building’s fluid design draws inspiration from the speed of the Dubai Autodrome and the natural flow of water, incorporating aerodynamic curves, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a prominent stone feature wall to create a striking visual identity.

Amenities within the development are tailored for lifestyle and wellness, including a rooftop infinity pool, a 7000 sq. ft. beach-edge pool, SkyFit Gym, yoga deck, steam and sauna rooms, a skate park, splash pad, children’s pool, and a sky garden. Additional features include a private cinema, co-working spaces, clubhouse, gaming lounges, a zen garden, landscaped green spaces, and a variety of recreational and fitness facilities to support a balanced and community-centric lifestyle.

Located in Al Hebiah First, 15 Cascade offers seamless access to key destinations such as Downtown Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Marina via major highways. It is also within minutes of prominent landmarks like First Avenue Mall, Dubai Autodrome, and Dubai Miracle Garden.

projects.name: Waada by Bahria Town

The project involves the construction of a master-planned residential development within the Waada Community at Bahria Town Dubai South. The development comprises four distinct sub-communities:   

  • Cascade Buildings at Waada
  • The Towers at Waada
  • Waada Townhouses
  • Waada Villas

Each sub-community is designed to offer a wide range of residential units, including studios, apartments, penthouses, townhouses, and luxury villas, catering to diverse lifestyle needs and preferences.

Waada is designed to deliver a premium living experience, blending modern architecture with a comprehensive array of amenities. Residential units feature smart home technology, spacious layouts, high-end finishes, and private gardens or balconies, with select villas offering private pools and waterfront views. The community offers on-site retail centers with international brands, as well as cafés and fine dining restaurants for a dynamic urban lifestyle.

Educational and healthcare facilities are integrated within the community, including schools, nurseries, clinics, and hospitals to support everyday needs. For recreation and wellness, Waada includes landscaped parks, jogging tracks, cycling paths, sports complexes, swimming pools, and spa centers. Additional amenities such as a banquet hall, basketball court, BBQ areas, a golf course, a kids’ play area, a fully equipped gymnasium, central A/C systems, and central gas connections contribute to a well-rounded, comfortable living environment.

With its thoughtful planning, modern infrastructure, and range of lifestyle offerings, the Waada Community sets a new benchmark for luxury residential developments in Dubai.

projects.name: Chelsea Residences by Damac
projects.description:

The master plan comprises six towers across two clusters:

  • Tower A: G+2P+25
  • Tower B: G+2P+28
  • Tower C: G+2P+30

Chelsea Residences 2

Together, the development will include over 1,400 premium residential units, offering a mix of apartments and luxury villas, each designed with sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf and access to exclusive Chelsea-branded amenities.

Key features of the development include Chelsea FC-branded fitness and wellness centres, an athlete performance studio, rooftop football pitch, and dedicated areas for aerial yoga and cryotherapy. Residents will also enjoy a private cinema, a Chelsea-themed sports bar, and a community lounge for live match screenings. Dining experiences will be elevated through a mono-diet café and the exclusive Captain’s Table, offering events featuring Chelsea legends. The architecture and interiors will combine Chelsea’s iconic identity with DAMAC’s contemporary design standards, delivering a distinctive and immersive living experience.

By integrating high-end living with elite football culture, Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is set to attract football fans, international investors, and high-net-worth individuals seeking a unique branded lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prominent seafront destinations.

The school campus will feature various indoor and outdoor activities such as football, tennis, basketball, multi-use play courts, and swimming pools. The campus will be constructed with a strong emphasis on sustainability, utilizing photovoltaic panels, water recycling, and other eco-friendly measures to aim for LEED Gold or Safat Gold green building certification.

In addition to the school facilities, 30,000 square feet of retail space will be developed adjacent to the school plot to contribute to its financial sustainability.

Managed under the MBRGI umbrella, the Mothers’ Endowment campaign provides a platform for individuals to honor their mothers by making donations in their name to support underprivileged communities sustainably through education. projects.name: City Walk Crestlane by Meraas

The project involves the construction of  premium waterfront residential project in City Walk, Dubai, offering modern urban living with luxury and sustainability. Designed to provide panoramic water views, the development integrates seamlessly with the City Walk streetscape, featuring a mix of mid-rise and high-rise buildings set among landscaped parks, cascading streams, and water features.

The initial phase of City Walk Crestlane consists of two mid-rise towers, City Walk Crestlane 2 and City Walk Crestlane 3, which together offer 394 residences, including a mix of one- to four-bedroom apartments and duplexes. The residences are designed with double-height living spaces, exclusive terraces, and high-quality finishes, featuring elegant kitchens, spacious bedrooms, and luxurious bathrooms.

City Walk Crestlane 2: Located in City Walk Phase 3, this multi-building complex consists of City Walk Crestlane 2 Building A and Building B. The development includes 201 residential units, incorporating a range of one- to four-bedroom apartments and duplexes. 

City Walk Crestlane 3: Also situated in City Walk Phase 3, City Walk Crestlane 3 mirrors its counterpart with two buildings—City Walk Crestlane 3 Building A and Building B. Developed by Meraas Holding through Citywalk Residential 1, it comprises 193 residential units, offering a variety of one- to four-bedroom apartments and duplexes.

City Walk Crestlane is designed to foster a vibrant, active lifestyle, featuring a fitness & wellness center, swimming pools, padel & tennis courts, a yoga studio, outdoor sports facilities, playgrounds, and jogging & cycling tracks. Residents can enjoy stunning views of the Dubai skyline or the shores of Jumeirah Beach.

Strategically positioned, the development offers convenient access to key districts, including City Walk, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Dubai Airport, and Jumeirah Beach, with connectivity via Al Safa, Al Wasl, Al Enjaz, and Al Multaqa streets.

City Walk Crestlane by Meraas is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 250.0 million, at concept. Developed by Meraas. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Rising seven floors above a basement parking level, the project offers a total of 212 residences, including one- to four-bedroom apartments.

Designed with an interlocking massing strategy, Solea presents a striking architectural identity while optimizing private and communal spaces. The façade blends glass and solid elements, ensuring natural light penetration, privacy, and energy efficiency. The design incorporates sustainable building strategies such as energy-efficient glazing, smart building technologies, and water-efficient landscaping to minimize environmental impact.

Solea offers resort-style amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and social connection. A modern gym, sports courts, and a jogging track cater to an active lifestyle, while BBQ areas, outdoor lounges, and boutique retail spaces create a vibrant community atmosphere.

Residents will have access to premium facilities, including a state-of-the-art gym, an outdoor cinema, and multipurpose recreational spaces. Floor-to-ceiling windows in each residence offer uninterrupted views of Saadiyat Island’s serene lagoons and skyline, enhancing the overall living experience.

Situated within the Saadiyat Lagoons District, Solea provides easy access to major cultural landmarks, including the Louvre Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Cultural District. projects.name: Sharjah Sports City - Sharjah Central Route
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a sports city in the Central Region of Sharjah. The project will cater to both team and individual sports, will feature four sports complexes and has been designed to host local, regional, and international events.

The design includes a central square, where four major roads converge from different directions: Al Madam, Al Badayer, Mahafiz and Al Bataeh, and Sharjah Sports City. At the heart of this square will stand the 'Sports City Stadium,' which will serve as the central feature of phase one of the project.

The stadium is envisioned as an architectural landmark, symbolizing a bird soaring over sand dunes. Its structure is composed of two main elements—the platform and grandstand, shaped to resemble the undulating dunes of the surrounding desert. The roof of the stadium, shaped like a bird with outstretched wings, changes color with the time of day, reflecting a silver hue in the morning and transitioning to a golden-red glow in the evening.

Sports City will feature advanced amenities, including an air-conditioned seating system with integrated cooling pipes. The stadium's design also prioritizes environmental sustainability, harmonizing with the natural landscape and reflecting the agility, speed, and strength of an athlete.

Residents will enjoy an array of world-class amenities, including private pools, state-of-the-art fitness centers, exclusive beachfront access, and vibrant community hubs that promote wellness and a balanced lifestyle. The architectural design incorporates soft, fluid lines, light-toned woods, and neutral palettes, evoking the serene elegance of the sea. projects.name: Fahid Beach Residences - Al Fahid Island
projects.description:
The project focuses on the construction of residential towers, designed to foster a vibrant and sustainable community lifestyle. Offering elegant 1-bedroom apartments and townhouses to opulent 5-bedroom penthouses, the development features a diverse mix of residential spaces, commercial areas, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated to create a harmonious living environment. The first phase, Fahid Beach Residences, comprises seven mid-rise buildings, each housing 65 residences, designed for comfort and style. In addition, a selection of luxurious villas will be available in 4-, 5-, and 6-bedroom layouts, many boasting stunning waterfront views. At the heart of the community lies a vibrant central hub, anchored by an expansive amenities podium and a community center that fosters connection, interaction, and a sense of belonging among residents.

Amenities:

  • Infinity Pool & Jacuzzi
  • Kids’ Pools & Splash Zones
  • Outdoor Fitness Areas
  • Pet Spa & Recreation Zones
  • Children’s Play Areas & Activity Rooms
  • Private Gym & Multi-Use Kitchens
Fahid Beach Residences - Al Fahid Island is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 200.0 million, at design. Developed by Aldar Properties Pjsc. Lead consultant Kengo Kuma & Associates,Koichi Takada Architects,Naga Architects, Designers & Planners (Dubai),Acme Co.; MEP consultant Naga Architects, Designers & Planners (Dubai). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Binghatti Ruby - Jumeirah Village Circle
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 26-story residential building in JVC District 16, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. The development will feature 627 units, including a mix of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with 45 office spaces and 10 retail units. The substructure will include a single basement level dedicated to parking.

Residents will enjoy a range of premium amenities, including a children's pool, a fitness center, a jogging track, a kids play area, a leisure deck, seating areas, a swimming pool, and a yoga studio.

Binghatti Ruby - Jumeirah Village Circle is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 230.0 million, at under construction (3.0 percent complete). Developed by Nakheel (Pjsc),Binghatti Holding (Binghatti Developers). Lead consultant Silver Stone Engineering Consultants. Main contractor Granada Europe Engineering Construction Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Damac Shoreline - Al Marjan Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a residential community on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, designed to cater to upscale lifestyles. It features a range of high-end units, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments from the 1st to the 16th floors, as well as premium townhouses on the ground level. The development prioritizes privacy and community, combining lush green spaces with modern infrastructure to offer a serene yet contemporary living environment.

The rooftop amenities include a Sunset Bar, Panorama View, Infinity Relax area, Zen Garden, and Yoga space, offering a perfect retreat with stunning vistas. On the ground level, the design creates a resort-like atmosphere with features such as adult and children's pools, a water sports area, an Aqua Oasis, a running track, an underwater viewing deck, a bamboo forest, a gym and spa, floating cabanas, and both waterfront and floating bars.

Strategically located just minutes from major landmarks such as Wynn Resort, Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, and Dubai International Airport, the project offers convenient access to key attractions while delivering an unparalleled luxury experience.

Damac Shoreline - Al Marjan Island is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 150.0 million, at tender. Developed by Damac Properties Co. Llc. Lead consultant International Engineering Center (Ras Al Khaimah),Kling Consult Gmbh (Dubai). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: RTA Drivers Accommodation Facility
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of an accommodation facility for drivers of the Roads & Transport Authority (RTA). The project will be executed using a build, operate, and transfer (BOT) framework within a public-private partnership model.

This PPP initiative will play a vital role in bolstering economic growth and advancing infrastructure in Dubai. Collaborative efforts with the private sector in implementing modern infrastructure projects ensure the enhancement of services for both citizens and residents. Such partnerships foster improved efficiency and innovation in service delivery, ultimately benefiting the community at large.

RTA Drivers Accommodation Facility is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 30.0 million, at concept. Developed by Roads & Transport Authority (Rta) (Dubai). No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.
